exposure: Binarized race (Black individuals and White individuals)
cohort: Female individuals aged 12 to 55 years with a live birth record identified between January 1, 2014, and December 31, 2018, who had greater than 80% enrollment through pregnancy to 60 days post partum and evidence of coverage for depression screening and mental health services.
finding: Clinical prediction models showed racial disparities in PPD and mental health service utilization, and methods like reweighing effectively reduced bias in these models, outperforming simply removing race from the models.
